description: Source code for a macOS ViewController managing a WebView, handling server start events, user settings, downloads, and JavaScript interactions within the Focalboard application.

classes.name: ViewController
classes.description: A macOS view controller managing a WebView, handling navigation, downloads, JavaScript messaging, and server events.

methods.name: viewDidLoad
methods.description: Initializes the view, sets up WebView delegates, clears cache, and loads homepage if server is started.

methods.name: viewDidAppear
methods.description: Sets the WebView as first responder when view appears.

methods.name: showDiagnosticsInfo
methods.description: Displays server port diagnostics in an alert.

methods.name: onServerStarted
methods.description: Handles server start event, updates session and loads homepage.

methods.name: updateSessionTokenAndUserSettings
methods.description: Injects session token and user settings into WebView via JavaScript.

methods.name: loadHomepage
methods.description: Loads the application's homepage in WebView.

methods.name: webView(_:runOpenPanelWith:initiatedByFrame:completionHandler:)
methods.description: Handles file open dialogs triggered from WebView.

methods.name: webView(_:decidePolicyFor:preferences:decisionHandler:)
methods.description: Decides whether to download or allow navigation based on response.

methods.name: webView(_:decidePolicyFor:decisionHandler:)
methods.description: Decides whether to allow or download based on MIME type.

methods.name: webView(_:navigationAction:didBecome:)
methods.description: Assigns delegate to download when navigation starts.

methods.name: webView(_:navigationResponse:didBecome:)
methods.description: Assigns delegate to download when response is received.

methods.name: webView(_:didFinish:)
methods.description: Handles actions after WebView finishes loading, disables context menu, and refreshes view if needed.

methods.name: refreshWebView
methods.description: Temporary workaround to fix rendering artifacts by resizing WebView.

methods.name: webView(_:didFailProvisionalNavigation:withError:)
methods.description: Handles navigation failure, retries loading homepage.

methods.name: webView(_:didFail:withError:)
methods.description: Handles navigation failure by making WebView visible.

methods.name: webView(_:createWebViewWith:for:windowFeatures:)
methods.description: Handles target=_blank links by opening in default browser.

methods.name: userContentController(_:didReceive:)
methods.description: Processes messages from JavaScript, updating user settings.
